justification: Both surfaces present a tall narrow vertical field combining a richly costumed standing human figure with a huge plumed headdress and long staff-like implement alongside a grid of squared sign-blocks, a distinctive and non-obvious pairing of figure plus script-like panels. The main differences in depicted content are that A appears to stack several figural registers with horizontal bands of sign-blocks running across its width, whereas B shows a single full-height figure with the sign-blocks confined to a column at one side, and A's figures are much less legible in posture and attribute detail.
